entities.name: Jani Hakanpää
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jani Hakanpää is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for Oulun Kärpät of the Finnish Liiga. Hakanpää was selected by the St. Louis Blues in the fourth round, 104th overall, of the 2010 NHL entry draft.
